subject: english
question:
**Change the following from active to passive: **

The team will be revising the algorithms during the workshop.

options.text: The algorithms were being revised during the workshop.
The algorithms will be been revised during the workshop.
The algorithms will be revised during the workshop.
The algorithms will be being revised during the workshop.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The algorithms will be being revised during the workshop .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the active voice: **"The team will be revising the algorithms during the workshop."**
 
• To convert the sentence into the passive voice:
 
 
• The subject ("The team") is dropped or replaced with "The algorithms" (object of the active sentence).
 
• The verb "will be revising" is changed to its passive form "will be being revised."
 
• The time frame ("during the workshop") remains unchanged.
 
 
 
• Thus, the passive form becomes: **"The algorithms will be being revised during the workshop."**

Correct sentence: *The algorithms will be being revised during the workshop*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action (e.g., "The team will be revising the algorithms").
 
• **Passive Voice:** The object of the active sentence becomes the subject, and the verb is changed to its passive form (e.g., "The algorithms will be being revised by the team").
 
• **Usage of "will be being":**
 
 
• This form is used in the passive voice to indicate an action that will be ongoing in the future.
 
• It adds a continuous aspect to the future passive construction.
